# DomAccess.measure reads the wrong node back for em and rem lengths

## Context

Found by reading while scoping #18874, where `measure` is the nearest sibling of the read that ticket adds. Verified at dev@b13719d1c1 **by reading only**: nothing in the repository exercises the branch, so there is no runtime sighting. Captured first as an A2A defect-note (2026-09-18), promoted here on the operator's escalation so it is not lost.

## The Problem

`Neo.main.DomAccess.measure({id, value})` converts one CSS length to px. For any unit other than `px` / `%` it sizes an off-screen measuring `div` and is meant to read that div's computed width back. It reads the **original node's** instead:

```js
const elStyle = node.ownerDocument.defaultView.getComputedStyle(node);   // :788 — the node
…
d.style.width = value;                                                   // :806 — the measuring div
// Read back the resulting computed pixel width
value = elStyle.width;                                                   // :809 — the node again
```

So `measure({id, value: '2em'})` answers the node's own width, as a String (`'412px'`), where its caller `component.Base#measure` documents `Promise<number>`. Unchanged since the method arrived in 16c9246418 (2023-09-10, floating auto-align, `#4851`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/main/DomAccess.mjs:778` `measure` — a remote method (the `remote.app` list, `:84`).
- Callers, repo-wide (`grep -rnE "\bmeasure\("` over `src apps examples test learn`): two.
  - `src/component/Base.mjs:1669` `measure(value)` forwards to the remote. **Nothing calls it**, today or at the introducing commit.
  - `DomAccess#getBoundingClientRect` (`:498`, `:501`) passes the **computed** `min-width` / `min-height`. A computed length is already px, so from here only the `parseFloat` branch runs; the comment above it ("in other units like em/rem etc") names a case the computed style has already resolved.
- Both callers gate on `lengthRE = /^\d+\w+$/` (`DomAccess.mjs:9`, `component/Base.mjs:17`). Measured with `node -e`: `14.4px`, `1.5em` and `50%` all fail it. Consequences, by reading:
  - a computed `min-width` of `14.4px` (`0.9em` at 16px) never lands on the rect, so `Rectangle#constrainTo` (`src/util/Rectangle.mjs:357`, `me.minWidth || me.width`) takes the current width as the minimum and answers `false` for any tighter constraint;
  - `component.measure('1.5em')` and `component.measure('50%')` return their input String unchanged;
  - the `%` branch (always the `offsetParent`'s **height**, for a width too) is reachable only through a direct remote call.

Net: the unit branch is wrong and unreachable from engine code today; what IS reachable is the regex gap on fractional computed minimums.

## The Fix

Recommended (A) — keep the documented contract and make it true:

1. `measure`: read `getComputedStyle(d).width`, `parseFloat` it, return a Number on every branch.
2. `lengthRE` at both sites: admit a fractional number. Decide `%` explicitly — axis-correct and reachable, or removed; the PR says which.
3. Arms in the component tier (the defect IS which node's computed style is read, so it needs a real DOM): `2em` on a node with a known font-size answers `2 × font-size` as a Number, not the node's width — red first; a fractional computed `min-width` lands on the rect.

Alternative (B) — delete the unreachable surface: `component.Base#measure` plus the unit and `%` branches, leaving `parseFloat` for the rect's computed minimums. Falsifier for A over B: a public remote and a public component method can have workspace callers this repository cannot see, so B is a breaking removal and the operator's release call. Falsifier for B over A: if no consumer is ever named, A maintains code nothing runs.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behaviour | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.main.DomAccess.measure` (remote) | `src/main/DomAccess.mjs:778` | a Number of px for any CSS length; the unit branch reads the measuring div | none | method docblock, `@returns {Number}` | red-first component arm |
| `Neo.component.Base#measure` | `src/component/Base.mjs:1669` | signature unchanged; fractional lengths reach the remote | none | docblock | arm |
| `rect.minWidth` / `rect.minHeight` from `getBoundingClientRect` | `src/main/DomAccess.mjs:497` | fractional computed minimums are reported | none | — | arm |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A red-first arm shows `measure` answering the node's width for an `em` length on dev, and `2 × font-size` as a Number after the fix.
- [ ] `measure` returns a Number on every branch.
- [ ] A fractional computed `min-width` / `min-height` is reported on the rect (arm).
- [ ] The `%` branch is either axis-correct and reachable, or removed — the PR says which and why.
- [ ] If (B) is chosen instead: the operator's ruling is linked and the removal is listed as breaking.

## Out of Scope

- The natural-size read #18874 adds beside `measure` — a different question (an element's own height, batched across ids).
- Floating / align behaviour beyond the min-size report.

## Avoided Traps

- Fixing only the readback: `getComputedStyle(d).width` still answers `'32px'`, a String.
- An arm in the unit tier over a stubbed DOM: a stub cannot tell which node's style was read.
